answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the grove of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the echo re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
